speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to examine the newborn. Please provide the history of the pregnancy, birth, and any specific symptoms or physical findings you have observed so far.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that background. Can you describe the specific physical findings or symptoms you have observed in the newborn, such as skin lesions, respiratory distress, or feeding difficulties?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a continuous "machinery-like" murmur, bilateral cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss is highly suggestive of Congenital Rubella Syndrome, especially given the lack of prenatal care. REQUEST TEST: Rubella_IgM_antibodies

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Rubella IgM confirms the diagnosis of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
